limitations.quote: I sampled `sel` on the rising clock edge and made the dispensing outputs active during the high clock phase.
limitations.note: The rewrite changed selection and output timing, simultaneous-coin handling, and change delivery, whereas the reference fix only corrects the 1-yuan transitions from 1 yuan to 2 yuan and from 1.5 yuan to 2.5 yuan.

limitations.quote: Pulses must end at the falling clock edge
limitations.note: The test required the rewrite’s half-cycle output timing and modeled its edge counting and queued refunds, so passing 10,000 randomized cycles did not establish compatibility with the original state machine.
